title: Poland and Romania Again Scramble Jets Overnight as Russia Launches 161-Drone Strike on Ukraine
detail: Russia launched 161 drones and an unspecified number of Banderol cruise missiles at Ukraine overnight into September 23; Ukrainian air defences intercepted or suppressed 119 drones and three missiles across 18 impact locations. In response, Poland's Operational Command scrambled military aircraft overnight and into Wednesday morning "to ensure safety," with the alert concluding after roughly an hour and no Polish airspace violation recorded. Romania's Ministry of National Defence radar separately detected an aerial target northeast of Vylkove, Ukraine, prompting a RO-ALERT message to northern Tulcea County residents at 23:35 and the scramble of two F-16s from the 86th Air Base at Borcea; the alert concluded roughly an hour later with no incursion into Romanian airspace.

media.caption: Russian strikes on Ukraine prompted overnight NATO scrambles in Poland and Romania
